title: Redeemer Extension: Certificates Issued in the Last 12 Months — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** A redeemer extension is added to the validity of a certificate reissued after a return, according to the certificate issue entries on the membership's rewards ledger dated in the last 12 months.

| Certificates issued in the last 12 months | Redeemer extension |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 6 days |
| 2 or 3 | 3 days |
| 0 or 1 | none |

Certificate issue entries are counted; reissue entries are not issue entries.

**Edges (hypothetical).** 1 certificate issued: none. 2: 3 days. 3: 3 days. 4: 6 days.
